verses.text: In the last days, the mountain of the LORD's temple will be set up as the highest of the mountains. It will be raised above the hills, and people will stream to it.

Many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the message of the LORD from Jerusalem.

He will judge between many peoples and settle disputes for strong nations far away. They will hammer their swords into plows and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, and they will never again train for war.
Everyone will sit under their own grapevine and under their own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid. The LORD of Armies has spoken.
All the nations may follow their own gods, but we will follow the LORD our God forever and ever.
"On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather those who are lame. I will bring together those who were driven away and those I have made to suffer.
I will make the lame into survivors, and those who were driven away into a strong nation. The LORD will rule over them on Mount Zion from that day on and forever."
And you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of the people of Zion, your former rule will be given back to you. The kingdom will return to the people of Jerusalem.
Why are you now crying out loud? Do you have no king? Has your adviser died, so that pain grips you like a woman giving birth?

Twist and groan, people of Zion, like a woman giving birth. Now you must leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There the LORD will save you from the power of your enemies.
But now many nations have gathered against you. They say, "Let her be made unclean. Let us look down on Zion with pleasure!"
But they do not know what the LORD is thinking. They do not understand his plan. He has gathered them like bundles of grain to the threshing floor.

"Get up and thresh, people of Zion! I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze, and you will crush many nations to pieces. You will give their stolen wealth to the LORD, their riches to the Lord of the whole earth."
